source.notes: Scanned school paper with no text layer; OCR corrected against the page images. Time printed as 2 1/2 hrs. No year is printed; examYear 2025 is taken from the file name (...-070325-2025) and the icseboard.org folder. Section A groups I-V (36 marks; group V is 'any 6' of 8 items, so its listed items total 8). Section B questions VI-XIII each carry one printed mark total (5) for parts a) and b) together, so each is kept as one entry; XIV carries (4). Fill-in-the-blank marks follow the number of blanks (10 blanks, (10) printed). Section A numbering restarts in each group, so the group numeral is stored as the question number and the item number as the part; the group instruction as printed is joined in front of each item. Handwritten strike-through and marks on page 3 and the page tally (22) are ignored; the icseboard.org watermark is ignored.
